steps.what: Show the stored layout of this industrial process.
Study industrial processes, including equipment placement, to maximize efficiency.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the layout already stored for this process. The mechanical engineer studies the process to maximize the efficiency of the equipment application, including where the equipment is placed. The layout does not study the floor. A layout with no process id leaves the study with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A layout from another line was treated as the study of this process.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored layout can be opened. The study still happens on the floor with the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A placement problem the layout does not show still has to be seen by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer studies the process. The layout is the record already stored.
tasks.altitude: The study stays on the floor. The stored layout is not the efficiency judgement.

reach.task: Use a placement this mechanical engineer has studied on this line.
reach.learn: A stored layout is not the study.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored layout is a lookup. It does not study the process or decide the equipment placement.
A layout from another line is not this study.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The process id and the layout already stored. The screen does not move equipment. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the layout on the operations record before the floor study.
unknowns: Whether placement notes and process notes share one layout record.
research_questions: Who confirms the layout matches the line now running?

already_counted.description: Studying the process and the placement stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop layouts whose process record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still studies the industrial process and the equipment placement. Only opening a layout already stored is removed. A layout from another line saves none of the study.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored product that this test must cover.
Design test control apparatus or develop testing procedures for products.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the product already recorded. The mechanical engineer designs the test control apparatus or develops the procedure for testing that product. The product record does not design the test. Only the procedure the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A procedure written for another product was filed as the test for this one.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored product can be opened. The apparatus and the procedure still have to be designed by the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A failure mode the product record does not mention still has to be covered by the engineer, or left out on purpose.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer designs the test. The product record is not the procedure.
tasks.altitude: The test design stays with the engineer. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Run a procedure this engineer has accepted for this product.
reach.learn: A product record is not the test.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored product record is a lookup. It does not design test apparatus or develop a testing procedure.
Filing a procedure before the engineer accepts that version would store a test nobody designed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The product id already stored. The procedure text is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the product record in the document store before writing the procedure.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether apparatus designs and written procedures share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms the product id is the product to be tested?

already_counted.description: Designing the apparatus or the procedure stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop procedures whose product record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: product id and the procedure text the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still designs the test control apparatus or develops the testing procedure. Only opening the product already recorded, and filing the procedure already accepted, is removed. A product id saves none of that design.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the machine condition already prescribed.
Establish safety procedures and the maintenance schedule for machines.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the condition already prescribed for this machine or equipment. The mechanical engineer establishes or coordinates the maintenance or safety procedure, the service schedule, or the supply of materials. The prescribed condition is not the procedure, and the procedure is not an automatic decision. Only the procedure the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A safety procedure was filed from a machine id, and the prescribed condition had not been read.
tasks.enabler_now: The prescribed condition can be opened. The procedure still has to be established by the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A hazard the condition does not mention still has to be written in by the engineer, or the procedure is not accepted.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer establishes the safety procedure. A machine id is not that procedure.
tasks.altitude: The safety procedure stays a decision of the engineer. The file stores only the version that engineer accepted.

reach.task: Review a safety procedure this engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A machine id is not the procedure.

evidence.claim: Opening a prescribed condition is a lookup. It does not establish a safety procedure, a service schedule, or a material supply.
A safety procedure for a machine is not an automatic decision. The engineer establishes it and stays responsible for the text.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The machine id and the prescribed condition already stored. The procedure text is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the prescribed condition in the document store before writing the procedure.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether safety procedures and service schedules share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms the prescribed condition is still the one for this machine?

already_counted.description: Establishing the safety or maintenance procedure stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop conditions whose machine record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: machine id and the procedure text the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still establishes the maintenance or safety procedure, the service schedule, or the material supply. Only opening the prescribed condition, and filing the procedure already accepted, is removed. A machine id saves none of that safety decision, and the procedure is not automatic.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the prospect already on the list.
Solicit new business with the prospect.

tasks.design: The {CRM} shows the prospect already listed. The mechanical engineer solicits the new business in the conversation. The list is not the solicitation. A prospect with no name leaves the conversation with the engineer. The screen does not send a pitch.
tasks.previous_blocker: A prospect title was treated as a call that had not been made.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored prospect can be opened. The solicitation still takes the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: A need the list does not mention still has to be heard from the prospect.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer solicits the business. The list is the record already stored.
tasks.altitude: Solicitation stays in the conversation. The prospect record is not the ask, and nothing is sent by the screen.

reach.learn: A prospect title is not the solicitation.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored prospect is a lookup. It does not solicit new business.
Sending a pitch from the prospect record would skip the conversation this task is.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The prospect id already stored. The screen does not send a message and does not add a pitch. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the prospect on the customer record before the conversation.
unknowns: Whether every prospect the engineer calls is already on the list.
research_questions: Who adds a prospect before the engineer calls?

already_counted.description: Soliciting the business stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop prospects who have asked not to be called.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still solicits the new business in the conversation. Only opening a prospect already listed is removed. A title saves none of the solicitation, and the screen does not send a pitch.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The mechanical engineer still studies the process, still designs the test, still writes the safety procedure, and still solicits the business. A stored record can be opened. It does not decide.
reach: Safety reviewers read a procedure only after this engineer has accepted it.
Sales people may open a prospect record, and this job learns the record is not the solicitation.
skills_to_grow: Study the process on the floor, including where the equipment sits.
Write a safety procedure as a decision, not as an automatic file.
Solicit business in the conversation, not from a prospect title.
role.ambitious_version: Process study, test design, safety procedures, and solicitation stay with the engineer. Stored records only show what was already written.
